### Observed differences

- In the later window, the most frequent successor of activity A38 changed: before, about 58 in 100 outgoing transitions went to A39 and about 36 in 100 to A35; after, about 54 in 100 went to A35 and about 41 in 100 to A39. [DIR001]
- All other successor shares are small (at most 2 in 100) in both windows. [DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a change in the process. The single observed difference is within the range expected by chance for an unchanged process (one item when 0.48 was expected), and it rests on a moderate number of traces (108 before, 100 after). [DIR001]
